hypothesis.statement: On the NREM (N2+N3) EEG of one real overnight polysomnogram (Sleep-EDF SC4001, Fpz-Cz), the amplitude of the sleep-spindle band (12-15 Hz) is coupled to the phase of the slow oscillation (0.5-1.25 Hz): the Tort modulation index is well above a circular-shift surrogate null, and phaseAmplitudeCoupling reproduces the canonical Python tensorpac to machine precision.

analysis_plan.dataset: Sleep-EDF Expanded (PhysioNet sleep-edfx), subject SC4001, EEG Fpz-Cz at 100 Hz; the first 30 min of concatenated NREM (N2+N3) epochs (from the expert hypnogram)

decision.threshold: descriptive: the SO-spindle Tort MI is significant vs a circular-shift surrogate null (z >= 3, observed above every surrogate) AND the op equals tensorpac to machine precision (|diff| < 1e-9)
